content.visible_text: Motorcycles Offers Finance Dealers FAQ About Contact Test Ride Book Now Our Story Born on Indian Roads, Built for Every Road. Apex Moto was born from a simple belief — that Indian riders deserved motorcycles that matched their passion, spirit, and ambition. Our Mission Redefining the Joy of Riding At Apex Moto, we don't just build motorcycles — we build experiences. Each machine in our lineup is the result of thousands of hours of engineering, testing on real Indian roads, and listening to the riders who trust us with their journey. We believe that a motorcycle is more than transport. It's freedom. It's character. It's the clearest expression of who you are and where you're going. 50K+ Happy Riders 120+ Dealerships 4 Iconic Models 10 Years of Excellence What We Stand For Our Design Philosophy Four principles that guide every decision, every design, every motorcycle we build. Precision Engineering Every tolerance, every material, every system is chosen for performance and longevity. Sustainable Progress Moving towards cleaner technologies without sacrificing the soul of motorcycling. Community First Our riders are our brand ambassadors. We build for them, with their feedback. Design with Purpose Beauty must serve function. Every curve, panel and line has a reason. Our Journey Milestones That Define Us 2014 Founded Apex Moto established in Pune with a vision to redefine Indian motorcycling. 2016 First Model Launch of the Phantom 350 — 10,000 units sold in the first year. 2018 National Reach Expanded to 50 dealerships across 20 Indian cities. 2020 Adventure Launch Thunderstrike 650 launches — our first twin-cylinder adventure bike. 2022 Street Division Storm 200 and Zenith 450 Scrambler join the lineup. 2024 50,000 Riders Apex Moto community crosses 50,000 registered riders nationwide. 2026 Next Chapter New flagship model in development. The journey continues. Ready to Experience Apex Moto? Visit your nearest dealership and book a complimentary test ride today. Explore Motorcycles Find a Dealer Born to Ride. Built to Last. Apex Moto crafts motorcycles that embody the spirit of the road — precision engineering, enduring quality, and the freedom to go anywhere.
